0022600106.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (2-0, 1st in the Atlantic, 3rd in the East) host the Milwaukee Bucks (0-2, 13th in the East, 5th in the Central and 2 games back) in the 76ers' third game of the season. Philadelphia won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 126-106 win in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. The 76ers are missing Ariel Hukporti (out after Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out with a back fracture), LeBron James (out with a back injury) and Tacko Fall (out with a quadriceps strain).
